description: This source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractDittoGraphStageLogic' that extends Akka's 'GraphStageLogicWithLogging' to add Ditto-specific stream processing functionality. It provides a method to pass elements from an inlet to an outlet with element transformation, handling flow control and completion.

classes.name: AbstractDittoGraphStageLogic
classes.description: An abstract class extending Akka's GraphStageLogicWithLogging, adding Ditto-specific stream processing capabilities including passing elements with mapping from inlet to outlet.

classes.name: PassAlongMapConcatHandler
classes.description: A private inner class extending AbstractInHandler and implementing Effect, responsible for handling the passing and mapping of stream elements from inlet to outlet.

methods.name: AbstractDittoGraphStageLogic
methods.description: Constructor initializing the graph stage logic with a specified shape.

methods.name: passAlongMapConcat
methods.description: Sets up flow from an inlet to an outlet with element mapping and handles initial emission, completion, and handler setup.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Trigger method to pull the next element from the inlet, used after emitting elements.

methods.name: onPush
methods.description: Called when an element is pushed to the inlet; applies the mapping function and emits to the outlet.

methods.name: onUpstreamFinish
methods.description: Called when upstream signals completion; triggers stage completion.

methods.name: onUpstreamFailure
methods.description: Handles failure from upstream, failing the stage.
